as_told.title: Engineered material extracted from within the mesa

plain: The claim is that a large metal object lies buried deep inside a mesa at Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property famous for reports of strange happenings. If true, something manufactured has been hidden in the rock for a long time. Michels first told it in 2022. He says the team of the ranch's owner used soil resistivity and ground-penetrating radar, two ways of sensing what lies underground, and found 'a large metallic object buried underneath the property below the mesa,' about 400 feet down. In that telling he credits team members named Aaron Blunt and Ravi Chandran. In a later episode, citing the TV series Secrets of Skinwalker Ranch, Michels says such objects have been located but are 'hard to actually extract because it's like they have a life of their own.' The ranch's owner, speaking first-hand on the show, goes further. He says, 'There's something under the mesa,' and speaks of 'extracting material that is manufactured, that's engineered from hundreds of feet within the mesa.' So Michels says the material resists removal, while the owner speaks as if some has been taken out.
